calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    -- sales: stores on the sale date, web on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, 
           p.category,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- returns reduce net sales on the return date
    SELECT r.return_date, 
           p.category,
           -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;

calls.statement:
WITH outdoor_lighting_skus AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p1.sku
    FROM dim_product p1
    JOIN dim_product p2 ON p2.sku = p1.sku AND p2.is_current
    WHERE p1.category = 'Garden' AND p1.category <> p2.category
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_count, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN outdoor_lighting_skus ol ON ol.sku = p.sku
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
  AND p.category = 'Garden';

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, 
           p.category,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, 
           p.category,
           -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label, COUNT(*) AS line_count, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE n.category = 'Garden'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 27 AND 52
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, d.fiscal_period_label
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period;
